title: Legacy program insiders on UFO materials

tellings.quote: that's how people who are in the quote unquote UFO legacy program talk about UFO materials.

plain: People inside what is called the UFO "legacy program", a supposed long-running secret effort said to hold UFO materials, have their own way of talking about those materials. Michels says so himself, without naming who these insiders are, while debating a well-known skeptic. He offers it to suggest that how someone talks about the materials can show whether they really have inside knowledge.
